newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's JSE says industrial index incorrect.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's JSE says industrial index incorrect.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange said on Tuesday an error had crept into the calculation of its industrial index, resulting in the level of the index being incorrect.
A JSE spokesman said the error related to a share split in index component Bearing Man over the weekend.
He said the exchange was working on recalculating the index and hoped to correct it by Wednesday morning.
